name: showreel-10-zero-js-transition
caption:
This page transition uses zero JavaScript. 🤯

CSS view transitions: tag the element on both pages with the same view-transition-name, add @view-transition { navigation: auto; } and the browser morphs it for you. Chrome 126, Edge 126, Safari 18.2.
Save it for your next build, or send it to a developer who still writes this in JS.
